regions.region: page 1 title, authors, abstract, and article metadata
regions.finding: Verified the source title and aggregate ligand-free CuTC allenylative C─P coupling claim. The online Supporting Information statement does not establish workspace association.

regions.region: page 1 Introduction and cited synthetic strategies
regions.finding: Classified the Horner–Mark rearrangement and prior transition-metal carboxylate/alcohol couplings as literature context rather than current-paper experiments.
Recorded the current generic CuTC ligand-free coupling class with generic R1/R2 groups; no experiment-specific yield or condition was assigned.
Linked the 1a/CuTC 65%, 1a/CuI no-product, and 1b/CuTC-or-CuI no-product observations to four separate Scheme 1 catalyst/substrate records shown on page 2.

unresolved: Equation 1 and cited literature classes contain generic structures and omit experiment-specific charges/conditions.
No workspace SI association is established.

regions.finding: Recorded four independent base-free tests under EtOH/0 °C/5 h/5 mol% catalyst: 1a with CuTC (65%), 1a with CuI (0%), and 1b with CuTC or CuI (each 0%).

regions.region: page 2 lower-left Table 1 reaction header, entries 1–7, and footnotes
regions.finding: Recorded all seven base-screen rows independently with 1a/2a/CuTC/base/EtOH charges, row times, the room-temperature/1.2-equiv override for entry 3, isolated yields, and entry-7 31P NMR yield plus 20% recovered 2a. Entry 3 is merged with Scheme 2 product 3a.

Mapped scope labels, qualitative trends, 3n/3n' isomerization, 3d scale-up, alternative CuI/TMEDA or CuTC/TMEDA results, no-reaction 3z, and dimethyl/diethyl phosphonate outcomes to the page-3 Scheme 2 rows without duplicating prose summaries.

unresolved: Main-text scope prose does not provide workups, purifications, atmospheres, or most isolated masses.
Transient 3n is approximately quantified only by immediate 1H NMR and has no separate isolated yield.
The publisher SI statement does not establish workspace SI association.

regions.region: page 3 full-width Scheme 2 reaction header, all product drawings, yields, times, temperatures, and footnotes a–c
regions.finding: Recorded every displayed product/condition independently: standard CuTC rows, eight separate ligand-assisted alternative-catalyst rows, the 3d 1 mmol scale-up, transient 3n/3n' behavior, qualitative nd for 3z, and <10% 31P NMR yield for 3ab. Shared charges and footnote reagents/loadings are structured as participants.

Linked the five competition experiments and two nonterminal-substrate failures to Scheme 3 on page 4. Figure/prose substrate-label conflicts for Equations 3–5 are retained rather than silently corrected.

regions.region: page 3 lower-right beginning of Scheme 4 discussion
regions.finding: Classified the CuTC/phosphinate/copper-acetylide/allenylcopper sequence as a proposed mechanism, not preparations of A–C.

unresolved: Scheme 2 omits atmosphere, EtOH volume, workup, purification, and nearly all masses.
Scheme 3 prose conflicts with the depicted labels in Equations 3 and 4; Equation 5 also contains an inconsistent printed ratio label.

regions.finding: Recorded five independent 0.2 mmol competition experiments with CuTC/i-Pr2NEt/EtOH at room temperature for 2 h, preserving total 31P NMR yields and product ratios. Conflicting prose labels remain explicit in notes/review.
The single generic arrow displays two nonterminal substrates (R=Ph or nBu); both were retained as separate 24 h no-reaction records without inventing conversion or recovery.
Recorded one proposed copper-allenylidene mechanism with ordered coordination, copper-acetylide formation, migration/acetate loss, and protonation steps. Intermediates A–C are not experiments.

regions.region: page 4 lower/right mechanism continuation and Conclusion
regions.finding: The prose completes the proposed mechanism and summarizes scope trends. It adds no new experiment beyond Scheme 3/4 and the page-3 scope records.

unresolved: Scheme 3 omits solvent volume, atmosphere, workup, purification, masses, and individual product yields.
Equation 3/4 prose labels conflict with the drawings; Equation 5 ratio text is internally inconsistent.
The exact catalytic mechanism remains unelucidated.

regions.region: page 5 left column acknowledgements, conflict statement, data availability, keywords, and references 1–9
regions.finding: Administrative text, an online supplementary-material availability statement, and bibliography only. No current-paper reaction arrow, table row, experimental procedure, reagent quantity, or outcome occurs.

regions.region: page 5 right column references 10–35 and manuscript dates
regions.finding: Bibliography and publication metadata only. Cited external work was not expanded into experiments of the current article.
